Independent full enumeration of 14 choose k landmark sets for k=0..5 found zero resolving sets below five and 168 edge-metric bases; all are exactly the same 168 subsets as vertex-metric bases. Constructed legal one-token jumps/slides: 420 jump edges, 5-regular connected graph; 168 slide edges, 21 components each C8. Original independent geometric certificate gives 84 noncollinear point-triple + 2 one-secant-line sets and 84 dual. The previously established vertex-base octagon classification plus verified equality supplies the host-cycle indexing. No generalization to larger planes claimed.
